measured_canonical_raw.note: The canonical raw contains Binance USD-M crypto-native perpetual klines, mark/index/premium klines and funding for BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/BNBUSDT/SOLUSDT, plus Binance spot, CBOE VIX, Deribit DVOL and FRED macro auxiliaries. It contains no NVDA/AAPL/TSLA/SPY equity-perpetual mark/index surface, no CME Globex ES/NQ surface, no primary-exchange official equity close surface and no order-book depth surface. The local crypto fields cannot express the registered equity-oracle mechanism.

host_wide_scan.note: Host scan is disclosure-only and cannot promote non-canonical stores into the canonical raw. Every lexical hit is classified; a complete local core surface would need the equity-perpetual and CME groups together, not merely a prose mention or an unrelated data file.
